item: Import-all: a failed append to import_results.jsonl is logged instead of dropped (R386)
summary: POST /api/markets/feeds/import-all wrote each click's outcome to import_results.jsonl (the debug bundle's imports member) under except Exception: pass, so a full disk or unwritable file made the click silently absent from the bundle. It now logs one warning through the scrubbing sink naming the file; the import result and tallies are unchanged.
